notes: Assumptions that change the number: 60 ml oil in the batter plus ~5 g brushed on the pan; all of the cinnamon sugar used; ~60 g lemon juice squeezed from the 2 lemons. Batter makes ~13 pancakes of 80 ml, about 2 a serving. Sanity check: USDA pancakes prepared from recipe (FDC 175009) is 227 kcal / 100 g; ours is ~200 kcal / 100 g (2337 kcal over ~1.16 kg of cooked pancakes and cinnamon sugar), because these are thin crêpe-style pancakes made with water as well as milk.
